title: Newly-proposed EU law could place tight restrictions on free-to-play games
description: The Digital Fairness Act, if adopted, could massively change the way some games are developed and published not just in Europe, but across the globe.

title: Development secrets of Dressmaker, ft. Ruan Rothmann & Sara Laubscher
description: Dressmaker is the kind of story indie devs dream of—so what did it take to bring the surprise hit of 2026 to life?

title: Witcher 3 devs use AI to help Polish voice actor reprise role of Geralt after stroke
description: After a stroke left him unable to do the voice of the Witcher series' main character anymore, Jacek Rozenek consented to using AI for Witcher 3's next expansion.

title: Tripwire Interactive lays off workers after announcing new publishing initiative
description: The Killing Floor studio lays off 36 in a move the former co-founder blames on 'woke leftists' ousting him from his position years ago.

title: GenAI-using developers say they mostly employ it for 'research and brainstorming'
description: A recent survey clocked AI-generated coding as the third-most common use case for industry professionals employing generative AI.

title: One in three developers say they've been laid off within the last two years
description: According to the State of the Industry survey, 34 percent of respondents have stated that they have been laid off in the last two years.

title: A second 2026 State of the Game Industry survey? It can happen! ft. Beth Elderkin & Imran Khan
description: On this week's BONUS episode of the GameDeveloper.com Podcast, we're diving into a second GDC Festival of Gaming State of the Industry report with all-new data on the world of game development

title: Layoffs, AI, and next-gen: what 2,600+ game professionals told GDC this year
description: The GDC State of the Game Industry Report returns with an up-to-date snapshot on the state of the professional world of game development.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after potentially damaging marital affairs
description: After multiple legally-compromising affairs came to light in the public, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has tendered his resignation as the head of one of the largest companies in the world.

title: PlayStation 5 crosses 100 million consoles sold
description: The 2020 console has exceeded 100 million consoles shipped, matching much of the PlayStation console line.

title: Tekken creator says he wishes hardware like the Xbox Series S 'wouldn’t be released'
description: The former general manager of Bandai Namco has some frustrations with Xbox's entry-level console and is not afraid to share them on a stage with other project leaders.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time exceeds 5 million copies sold in first week
description: The remake of the 1998 game becomes the second-highest selling Switch 2 title in only four days.

title: Report: PlayStation's Fairgames cancelled, no devs to be laid off
description: After being announced in 2023, the online multiplayer shooter will never see the light of day, according to a new report.

title: Take-Two CEO: Grand Theft Auto VI pre-orders are exceeding expectations
description: It's not entirely clear what those expectations were, but Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick is boasting about the game's sales on the eve of its long-anticipated release.

title: Report: Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor lays off an unspecified number of staff
description: A few months after the game's release, it looked like maybe Bit Reactor was putting itself back together, but a new report indicates that the Star Wars tactical title's developer is suffering layoffs.

title: How it feels to have your game cloned
description: Turns out: no one is immune to AI-generated clone games.

title: The History of Every Video Game Genre
description: From racing and sports, to shoot 'em ups and platformers, to fighting games and first-person shooters, to cozy games and friendslop, this is the history of every video game genre. Ever.

title: Word Play is now available on iOS!
description: Word Play is now available on iPhone and iPad. Get the free trial here

title: 100 Steam Games that started life during GMTK Game Jam
description: There are more than 100 games on Steam that started life during one of our GMTK Game Jam events. To celebrate these amazing developers, let's look at 100 games that made the jump from jam to Steam.

title: How I Coded the Perks in my Roguelike
description: Word Play is my vocabulary roguelike, with over 100 passive perks. Implementing them into the game meant learning a whole new type of coding architecture: inheritance.

title: The Secrets Behind THAT Cyberpunk 2077 Montage
description: Here's a super quick bonus video, looking at the famous montage from Cyberpunk 2077. How did CD Projekt Red make a cinematic sequence with 15 location changes, 79 cuts, and three mirror shots? Let's find out.

title: How Rockstar fit an entire city into PlayStation 2 memory
description: With Grand Theft Auto III, Rockstar North performed a magic trick: it squeezed an entire 4 kilometre wide city into the tiny 32 megabyte chip of the PlayStation 2. Here's how they did it.

title: Has Zelda Changed Forever?
description: The Legend of Zelda series turns 40 years old this month. Let's look at the two distinct eras of the franchise, ask why Nintendo made the shift, and look at what might come next.

title: The World Design of Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Team Cherry returns to the world of Hollow Knight with Silksong - a new game, with a new character, in a whole new world. In this episode of Boss Keys let's look at how the developers designed Pharloom and the Citadel, and how they thought about topics like progression, backtracking, and optional content.

title: What's the Point of Prototyping?
description: With a game idea under your belt, it's time to test it out. And the best way to do that is with a prototype. Find out why, and get tips for making your own, in episode two of Game Dev 101.

title: How Games Do Destruction
description: Let's talk about video game destruction, and break down the techniques used to dent cars, break boxes, tear through scenery, and blow up buildings.

title: What's The Point Of Hard Games, Anyway?
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the latest game to join the "difficulty in games" debate. In this Mini episode of GMTK, let's look at why, and how, designers implement a high level of challenge in their games.

title: My Favourite Games from GMTK Game Jam 2025
description: This year's GMTK Game Jam was all about loops. Here are 20 of my favourite entries to the jam - from programming chefs to time-travelling crows.

title: I've waited my whole life for this
description: Switch 🇪 🇸 USA - Xbox 🇪 🇸 USA - PlayStation 🇪 🇸 USA
